You asked this just before, so this uses the score I got then. I didn't check it again.

**C-1088 scores 22.2, which is in the High band.** The suggested action is "Assign an investigator."

**Treatment pattern (BI, category score 59.6)**
- **BI-2 Medical build-up (+5.26):** The adjuster file says visits rose to "nearly daily" and are "well beyond what is usual for a strain of this kind" (C-1088-adjuster_file, page 1).
- **BI-3 Mostly subjective findings (+3.51):** Imaging and exams were normal. The findings rest mostly on the patient's own report of pain (C-1088-medical_records, page 2).
- **BI-5 Attorney before first treatment (+2.63):** The attorney was hired on 2024-12-16. The first visit was on 2024-12-23.
- **BI-6 Heavy early treatment (+3.51):** There were 15 visits in the first 30 days after the 2024-12-15 loss.

**Network links (NL, category score 36.4)**
- **NL-3 Same clinic and same attorney (+4.24):** 10 other claims also use Harrington Physical Therapy and attorney David Richardson.
- **NL-6 Large linked cluster (+3.03):** C-1088 is part of a group of 12 linked claims.

**Limits of this score**
- Coverage is 90.1%. Rules AS-6, CT-7 and NL-5 could not run, so the score may be a little too low.
- The score shows an unusual pattern that needs human review. It is not a finding of fraud.
